changes.comment: Stage 6e review correction: dispatcher-service/dispatcher-workflows.ts and its DispatcherWorkflows wrapper class are deleted. DispatcherService now constructs its dispatcher-scoped WorkflowService directly in its own constructor, the same way it already constructs SchedulerService; DispatcherLifecycle fans Workflow start/recover/close-admission out to the Team scope (teams.startWorkflows()/recoverWorkflows()/closeWorkflowAdmissions()) explicitly, beside the equivalent scheduler fan-out, instead of a wrapper class hiding that fan-out. Pure internal restructuring: the dispatcher.workflows Commands/MCP surface, its run/stop admission gating, and its status/list reads are unchanged.
